name: Blue Eyes, primite
extraDeck: Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres

combos.name: EXPERT — Ether Beryl + Sage + Any Card
combos.result: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon + Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon + Primite Drillbeam + Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon protection + True Light/Wishes follow-up + Blue-Eyes on field.
combos.sourceNote: Core sequence cross-checked against current Blue-Eyes Primite guides and published combo demonstrations. The exact endboard can change with the third card, available Extra Deck slots, or interruption; this is the clean no-interruption line.

steps.title: 1. Normal Summon Ether Beryl
steps.action: Normal Summon Primite Dragon Ether Beryl.
steps.why: Ether Beryl is the Primite starter. With Sage available, you want Ether Beryl to generate the Primite package before committing the Blue-Eyes Normal Summon.

steps.title: 2. Set Primite Lordly Lode
steps.action: Activate Ether Beryl's on-summon effect and Set Primite Lordly Lode from the Deck.
steps.why: Lode is the Primite bridge to Drillbeam and later lets you put Blue-Eyes White Dragon on the field without consuming the Normal Summon.

steps.title: 3. Search Primite Drillbeam
steps.action: Activate Primite Lordly Lode and add Primite Drillbeam from the Deck.
steps.why: You are banking an additional interaction piece before starting the longer Blue-Eyes sequence.

steps.title: 4. Link Ether Beryl away
steps.action: Link Summon Spirit with Eyes of Blue using Primite Dragon Ether Beryl.
steps.why: Spirit with Eyes of Blue converts the Primite starter into access to Mausoleum of White.

steps.title: 5. Search Mausoleum
steps.action: Activate Spirit with Eyes of Blue's effect and add Mausoleum of White from the Deck.
steps.why: Mausoleum is what gives you the second Normal Summon for Sage.

steps.title: 6. Activate Mausoleum
steps.action: Activate Mausoleum of White.
steps.why: You need its additional Normal Summon effect to put Sage on the field after using Ether Beryl's Normal Summon.

steps.title: 7. Normal Summon Sage
steps.action: Use Mausoleum's additional Normal Summon to Normal Summon Sage with Eyes of Blue.
steps.why: This is the Blue-Eyes engine's critical tuner/search step.

steps.title: 8. Search Maiden
steps.action: Activate Sage with Eyes of Blue and add Maiden of White from the Deck.
steps.why: Maiden is both a Level 1 tuner and the card that establishes True Light from the Deck.

steps.title: 9. Put True Light on the field
steps.action: Send Maiden of White to the GY with its effect and place True Light face-up from the Deck.
steps.why: True Light gives you the next Blue-Eyes Spell/Trap search and another Blue-Eyes summon route.

steps.title: 10. Load Blue-Eyes into the GY
steps.action: Use Mausoleum of White targeting Spirit with Eyes of Blue; send Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck to the GY.
steps.why: You deliberately put the Normal Monster in the GY so Spirit can convert itself into Blue-Eyes.

steps.title: 11. Tribute Spirit to revive Blue-Eyes
steps.action: Tribute Spirit with Eyes of Blue to Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the GY.
steps.why: Spirit's tribute effect is the central bridge into the Synchro line.

steps.title: 12. Revive Maiden
steps.action: Because Blue-Eyes White Dragon was Special Summoned, activate Maiden of White in the GY to Special Summon Maiden.
steps.why: Now you have Blue-Eyes plus the Level 1 tuners needed to make the first Spirit Dragon.

steps.title: 13. Synchro Summon Spirit Dragon #1
steps.action: Synchro Summon Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon using Blue-Eyes White Dragon + Sage with Eyes of Blue.
steps.why: This is the first Level 9 Synchro body and will later become Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon.

steps.title: 14. True Light sets Wishes
steps.action: Activate True Light and Set Wishes for Eyes of Blue from the Deck.
steps.why: Wishes is the key 2-card search that supplies the second Blue-Eyes body and an additional Level 1 LIGHT monster/hand-trap resource.

steps.title: 15. Activate Wishes
steps.action: Activate Wishes for Eyes of Blue, discard the spare card from your hand, and add Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons + Effect Veiler from the Deck. If Roar is already in hand, use the second search for the appropriate Blue-Eyes Spell/Trap/follow-up instead.
steps.why: Wishes converts one spare card into two exact resources. Effect Veiler is searchable here and can remain as insulation.

steps.title: 16. Special Summon Blue-Eyes with Roar
steps.action: Activate Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons to Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck.
steps.why: This gives you the second Blue-Eyes body required to make the second Spirit Dragon without using another Normal Summon.

steps.title: 17. Equip Neo Ultimate protection
steps.action: Banish Wishes for Eyes of Blue from the GY and equip Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon from the Extra Deck to a Blue-Eyes White Dragon as an Equip Spell.
steps.why: This grants targeting protection and converts Wishes' GY effect into permanent value on the board.

steps.title: 18. Synchro Summon Spirit Dragon #2
steps.action: Synchro Summon the second Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon using the remaining Blue-Eyes White Dragon + Maiden of White.
steps.why: Two Spirit Dragons are the material bridge into Ultimate Spirit Dragon and Crimson Dragon.

steps.title: 19. Spirit Dragon #1 → Ultimate Spirit
steps.action: Use the first Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon's tag effect to Special Summon Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon from the Extra Deck.
steps.why: Ultimate Spirit Dragon is your major field-effect interaction/negate.

steps.title: 20. Spirit Dragon #2 → Crimson Dragon
steps.action: Use the second Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon's tag effect to Special Summon Crimson Dragon from the Extra Deck.
steps.why: Crimson Dragon is the bridge to the Level 12 Synchro boss.

steps.title: 21. Crimson Dragon → Stardust Sifr
steps.action: Activate Crimson Dragon targeting Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon, then Special Summon Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon from the Extra Deck.
steps.why: Sifr adds another monster-effect interaction layer and protection to the final board.

steps.title: 22. Recover Blue-Eyes with Lordly Lode
steps.action: Activate Primite Lordly Lode, declare Blue-Eyes White Dragon, and Special Summon Blue-Eyes from the GY when the board state permits.
steps.why: This leaves a Normal Monster available for Primite Drillbeam and gives you another body/follow-up.

steps.title: 23. Set Drillbeam and remaining interaction
steps.action: Set Primite Drillbeam and any remaining traps/hand traps. Keep Effect Veiler in hand if you searched it with Wishes.
steps.why: Drillbeam is strongest when you control a Normal Monster; the completed board should retain both boss interaction and a Primite interaction.

steps.title: 24. EXPERT END-BOARD CHECK
steps.action: Before ending the turn, confirm: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon, Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon, Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon equipped to a Blue-Eyes, Primite Drillbeam available, True Light/Wishes resources, and any remaining hand traps.
steps.why: The expert line is about preserving layered interaction and follow-up, not simply filling every zone.

combos.name: EXPERT — Ether Beryl 1-Card Line
combos.result: Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres + Primite Drillbeam + Blue-Eyes follow-up.

steps.title: Normal Summon Ether Beryl
steps.action: Normal Summon Primite Dragon Ether Beryl and Set Primite Lordly Lode.
steps.why: Start Primite without spending a Blue-Eyes card.

steps.title: Search Drillbeam
steps.action: Activate Lordly Lode and add Primite Drillbeam.
steps.why: Bank your interaction before extending.

steps.title: Make Spirit with Eyes of Blue
steps.action: Link Summon Spirit with Eyes of Blue using Ether Beryl and search Mausoleum of White.
steps.why: This gives you a Dragon body and access to Blue-Eyes resources.

steps.title: Summon Blue-Eyes with Lode
steps.action: Activate Lordly Lode declaring Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Special Summon Blue-Eyes from the Deck when legal.
steps.why: You now have two Dragon bodies without needing a second starter.

steps.title: Make Hieratic Seal
steps.action: Link Summon Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres using Blue-Eyes White Dragon + Spirit with Eyes of Blue.
steps.why: Seal gives you a bounce on the opponent's turn and converts itself into another Dragon when Tributed.

steps.title: Opponent-turn Seal line
steps.action: On the opponent's turn, use Hieratic Seal to bounce a face-up card; then Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck with Seal's effect when appropriate.
steps.why: This creates a bounce plus a Blue-Eyes Normal Monster on the field.

steps.title: Drillbeam interaction
steps.action: With Blue-Eyes on the field, activate Primite Drillbeam when its conditions are met to negate and banish the opponent's face-up card.
steps.why: The 1-card Primite line ends with two distinct interaction points and follow-up.

combos.name: EXPERT — Wishes for Eyes of Blue Branches
combos.result: Wishes branches into Sage/Blue-Eyes or Maiden/True Light lines depending on the other cards in hand.

steps.title: Activate Wishes
steps.action: Discard a card and activate Wishes for Eyes of Blue.
steps.why: Wishes searches a Level 1 LIGHT Tuner and a Blue-Eyes Spell/Trap, so the correct targets depend on the rest of your hand.

steps.title: If you lack Sage: search Sage
steps.action: Add Sage with Eyes of Blue when your hand needs the Sage starter line.
steps.why: Sage converts into Maiden and gives you access to the True Light setup.

steps.title: If you already have Sage: search Maiden
steps.action: Add Maiden of White instead when Sage is already in hand and you need the True Light route.
steps.why: Avoid adding a redundant Sage when Maiden is the missing piece.

steps.title: Choose Roar or True Light support
steps.action: Use the Blue-Eyes Spell/Trap search to obtain Roar, True Light, or the appropriate follow-up based on your existing hand.
steps.why: Expert play is hand-dependent: don't blindly copy the same target every time.

steps.title: Transition into the full line
steps.action: From the chosen branch, follow the Ether Beryl + Sage sequence when both Normal Summons can be established.
steps.why: The goal is to arrive at the same layered Synchro endboard while preserving the most resources.
